issues.title: Manga reader enhancements like Komikku
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

Please add the following enhancements to the Manga reader. These enhancements are currently implemented in Komikku.
1. Progress slider should be flipped (if reading mode is right to left (manga style)).
2. Double pages should be zoomed into (start from full overview of the double page then zoom into the right part) and when the next page button is pressed the zoom should advance to the left.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
- Describe the current functionality or lack thereof.

1. The progress bar advances as usual, from left to right. When the reading mode is changed to Manga style, the progress bar feels out of place and inconsistent (since you'd probably change the next button to be on the left as well and when you advance the progress bar moves right, the opposite of what you press). It's also awkward to use the progress bar to seek through pages because you'd be going the opposite way of the bar.

2. Double pages are shown as a full overview, sometimes being too small to read so you'd have to double press to zoom in or pinch (this can sometimes lead into misclicks and advance the page instead which is annoying). 

### Proposed Solution
- Detail how the feature should work and any potential benefits.

1. Progress bar should be flipped if your reading mode is right to left. This would make it more consistent with the reading mode and you can seek through the pages through the bar more easily.
 
2. Double pages should be zoomed in (start from a double page overview and zoom into the right part of the page, basically acting like a single page). When you press the 'next page' button the zoom should move to the other part of the double page and then proceed onto the next page when that button is pressed again.

### Considerations
- Mention any potential challenges or alternatives.
Not sure, will update if I can think/find any.

### Additional Context

Demo of the progress bar from Komikku

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/0e4eea45-7cc2-4f56-a199-bafb94f5414f

Demo of the zoom feature from Komikku (When I enter a double page the zoom is automatic)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c5aba4e8-9a23-4fa1-aee5-c34a36041b1a

issues.title: Please add a Story feature, similar to Dantotsu
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

**Dear @RyanYuuki and @itsmechinmoy,**

In Dantotsu, the Story and Friend Watching and Rating List features only work for users who use AniList. Although watched anime can be added automatically (similar to Anymex), these features only display AniList friends.

I would like to request that you implement a similar feature, but designed in the Anymex way. The Story feature help users see what their friends are currently watching. 

#### Please find the attached screenshot below, where the Story feature is highlighted:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93601621-94c3-4938-a0d3-34213771cffe)

I sincerely hope you consider implementing these features in the future, as they would greatly improve the overall user experience.

Thank you.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
- In Dantotsu, the Story feature is only available for users who use AniList.
- Even though watched anime can be added automatically, social features remain limited to AniList connections.
- Users who do not rely on AniList cannot fully benefit from these features.

### Proposed Solution
- Implement a Story feature within Anymex that is independent of AniList limitations.
- Allow users to see what their friends are currently watching.
- Improve social interaction and overall user experience within the app.

### Considerations
- Cross-platform compatibility may be required (AniList / MyAnimeList / native Anymex accounts).
- Privacy controls should be considered for activity visibility.
- Synchronization of watch status and ratings may introduce technical complexity.
- An alternative approach could be optional linking of external accounts while maintaining native functionality.


### Additional Context

I will attach a screen recording from my Dantotsu app where the Story and Friend Watching and Rating List features are highlighted. Please review the video and consider implementing similar features in both the PC and smartphone versions of the app.

You may integrate AniList and MyAnimeList, or alternatively, develop a native cross-platform system where users can log in or create an account to access advanced features. 

#### This could allow users to:
- View what their friends are currently watching or reading
- See ratings for anime, manga, and novels
- Sync watch/read progress and timestamps between phone and PC simultaneously
- Use Story and Friend activity features across devices
- Follow or connect with friends and track their activity

Below, I have attached the screen recording for reference:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3b5d761-41f7-49a2-b5c8-185b40d2d3b3

I hope that by reviewing the information I have provided, as well as the screenshots and screen recording video, you will find them helpful and consider implementing these features as soon as possible.

issues.title: Add Torrent Play Support like Dantotsu
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

**Dear @RyanYuuki and @itsmechinmoy,**

Please add Torrent playing support just like Dantotsu has. It will solve most of the watching problem. You can also make it like Stremio app. Playing torrent will help to play any Anime within the app without facing other extension's not showing or playing problem.

Please add this feature as soon as possible.

Thank You.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
- No functionality of play Torrent extensions video for example Torrentio Anime extension's Torrent Files

### Proposed Solution
- Dantotsu can play Torrent Files. Just take some of the coding from Dantotsu

### Considerations
- If you can improve the Torrent support then please improve the Dantotsu Torrent support to more powerful Torrent Player.
